blocks.en: 2.1.4 Peristaltic Pump Advantages and Disadvantages

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PP 技術特性全貌
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Full Picture of PP Technology

blocks.zh: 這張優缺點表是選型決策的基礎。蠕動泵 (Peristaltic Pump, PP) 的核心工作原理是「管外壓縮推進」——液體永遠不接觸泵的金屬部件，泵頭的滾輪 (roller) 在管外擠壓矽膠管，推動液體前進。
blocks.en: This advantages and disadvantages table is the basis for the selection decision. The core working principle of the peristaltic pump (PP) is "compression from outside the tube": the liquid never touches the metal parts of the pump, and the rollers on the pump head squeeze the silicone tubing from the outside to push the liquid forward.

blocks.zh: 這個設計帶來兩個根本優勢：
blocks.en: This design brings two fundamental advantages:

blocks.zh: 低剪切 (low shear)：對蛋白質藥物、脂質體、細胞治療產品非常友善，幾乎不造成分子損傷
blocks.en: Low shear: very gentle on protein drugs, liposomes and cell therapy products, causing almost no molecular damage

blocks.zh: 天然封閉系統：泵體可放置在無菌屏障外，大幅降低 Grade A 區域的汙染源
blocks.en: Inherently closed system: the pump body can sit outside the sterile barrier, greatly reducing sources of contamination in the Grade A area

blocks.zh: 同時也有一個根本限制：橡膠管是唯一的耗損點，所有的 SA 風險、成本問題、維護計畫都圍繞管路展開。
blocks.en: It also has one fundamental limitation: the elastomer tubing is the only wear point, and all SA risks, cost issues and maintenance plans revolve around the tubing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：洗車機的海綿滾輪
blocks.en: Analogy: The Sponge Rollers of a Car Wash

blocks.zh: 想像洗車機的旋轉海綿滾輪——它們接觸車身（管壁），但洗車水（液態藥品）不接觸滾輪本身。PP 的原理相同：滾輪壓縮管子外壁，車（藥液）在管道內安全通過。
blocks.en: Picture the rotating sponge rollers in a car wash. They touch the car body (the tube wall), but the wash water (the liquid drug product) never touches the rollers themselves. PP works the same way: the rollers compress the outer wall of the tube, and the car (the drug solution) passes safely through inside the tube.

blocks.zh: 問題在於：長時間洗車後，海綿滾輪會磨損脫落碎片——PP 的矽膠管也一樣。所以「滾輪使用壽命驗證」是這個系統的核心品質控制活動。
blocks.en: The catch is that after long hours of washing, the sponge rollers wear and shed fragments, and PP silicone tubing does the same. That is why "tubing use-life validation" is the core quality control activity of this system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：高黏度產品排除
blocks.en: Key Point: High-Viscosity Products Are Excluded

blocks.zh: PP 不適用於高黏度產品（如某些懸浮液、凝膠製劑）。高黏度會增加管路的壓縮阻力，導致劑量精準度下降，並加速管壁磨損。
blocks.en: PP is not suitable for high-viscosity products (such as some suspensions and gel formulations). High viscosity increases the compression resistance of the tubing, reducing dosing accuracy and accelerating tube wall wear.

blocks.zh: CDMO 接案關鍵問題：當客戶問「你們可以充填高黏度藥液嗎？」若生產線只有 PP，答案可能是「需要先做可行性評估」。RPP 或 TP 在高黏度場景通常更可靠。
blocks.en: Key question when taking on CDMO projects: when a client asks, "Can you fill a high-viscosity drug solution?", if the line has only PP, the answer may be "we need to do a feasibility assessment first". RPP or TP is usually more reliable for high-viscosity applications.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 多品項靈活性
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Multi-Product Flexibility

blocks.zh: 「劑量範圍廣」是 PP 在 CDMO 場景最有商業價值的優點。只要更換不同管徑的 SU 管路，同一台泵頭可以充填從 0.01 mL 到 50 mL 的多種規格，不需要更換泵體主機。
blocks.en: "Wide dose range" is the PP advantage with the greatest commercial value in a CDMO setting. By simply changing to SU tubing of a different diameter, the same pump head can fill a range of formats from 0.01 mL to 50 mL, without changing the pump drive unit.

blocks.zh: 對比 RPP：每個劑量規格通常需要專用活塞/缸體，換規格等同硬體更換。
blocks.en: By comparison with RPP: each dose format usually requires a dedicated piston/cylinder, so changing format amounts to a hardware change.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的競爭優勢因此顯現：一條 PP 生產線可服務更多客戶品項，資產利用率更高。
blocks.en: This gives the CDMO a competitive advantage: one PP line can serve more client products, with higher asset utilization.

blocks.zh: 2.1.5 Peristaltic Pump Sterility Assurance: Microbial and Total Particles 2.1.5 蠕動泵無菌保證：微生物與微粒總量
blocks.en: 2.1.5 Peristaltic Pump Sterility Assurance: Microbial and Total Particles

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PP 的 SA 優勢來源
blocks.en: Core Concept: Where the PP SA Advantage Comes From

blocks.zh: PP 在無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance, SA) 上的優勢有兩個獨立來源：
blocks.en: The advantage of PP in sterility assurance (SA) has two independent sources:

blocks.zh: SU 預裝伽瑪滅菌 (gamma-irradiated SU)：管路出廠前已完成輻射滅菌，批次開始前無需進行就地滅菌，大幅減少操作步驟和無菌連接次數。這是 PP + SU 組合的核心優勢。
blocks.en: Gamma-irradiated pre-assembled SU: the tubing has already been sterilized by irradiation before it leaves the supplier, so no sterilize-in-place is needed before a batch starts, greatly reducing handling steps and the number of aseptic connections. This is the core advantage of the PP + SU combination.

blocks.zh: 泵體置於屏障外：PP 是極少數可以完全放在 Grade A 隔離器或 RABS 屏障外面的充填技術。這代表機械部件產生的微粒（金屬摩擦屑、潤滑劑）完全不會進入關鍵區域——只有透明的矽膠管穿過屏障進入充填區。這是 SA 的結構性優勢，不是操作技巧。
blocks.en: Pump body outside the barrier: PP is one of very few filling technologies that can be placed entirely outside a Grade A isolator or RABS barrier. This means that particles generated by mechanical parts (metal wear debris, lubricants) never enter the critical zone; only the transparent silicone tubing passes through the barrier into the filling area. This is a structural SA advantage, not an operating technique.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：管路磨損是 PP 的核心 SA 風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Tubing Wear Is the Core SA Risk of PP

blocks.zh: PP 的 SA 最大風險集中在兩個層面：
blocks.en: The greatest SA risks of PP are concentrated at two levels:

blocks.zh: 1. 微粒產生 (particle generation)：滾輪持續壓縮矽膠管 → 管壁橡膠碎片脫落 → 進入藥液。關鍵管控措施：驗證並設定管路使用時間上限，並在驗證中考慮不同藥品基質對矽膠降解速率的影響（如有機溶劑可能加速老化）。
blocks.en: 1. Particle generation: the rollers continuously compress the silicone tubing, so rubber fragments shed from the tube wall and enter the drug solution. Key control measure: validate and set a maximum tubing use time, and consider in the validation the effect of different drug product matrices on the silicone degradation rate (for example, organic solvents may accelerate ageing).

blocks.zh: 2. 可抽提物/可滲出物 (extractables & leachables, E&L)：PP 的管路比其他技術更長、材料種類更多（不同硬度的管段），且長期承受摩擦力和拉伸力，因此 E&L 測試必須覆蓋全部材料種類 × 全部曝露條件（時間、溫度、摩擦力）的矩陣，不能只測一個代表性條件。
blocks.en: 2. Extractables & leachables (E&L): PP tubing is longer than in other technologies, uses more material types (tube sections of different hardness), and is under friction and stretching forces over a long period. E&L testing must therefore cover a matrix of all material types × all exposure conditions (time, temperature, friction); testing a single representative condition is not enough.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：小裂縫的隱患 — 為什麼 PP 比 RPP 更需要 100% IPC
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hidden Risk of Small Cracks - Why PP Needs 100% IPC More Than RPP

blocks.zh: 這是 PP 一個容易被忽略的 SA 風險：矽膠管的小裂縫或接頭微洩漏，在外觀上可能看不出來，劑量偏差也很小（因為裂縫只是洩漏幾滴）。
blocks.en: This is an easily overlooked SA risk of PP: small cracks in the silicone tubing or minor leaks at connectors may not be visible, and the dose deviation is also very small (because the crack leaks only a few drops).

blocks.zh: 如果採用統計 IPC（每 N 個容器量一次重量），一個在第 1 個容器後就開始洩漏的管路，可能到第 N 個才被偵測到。這 N-1 個容器可能都是次品。
blocks.en: With statistical IPC (weighing one container every N containers), a tube that starts leaking right after the 1st container may not be detected until the Nth. Those N-1 containers could all be defective.

blocks.zh: 結論：100% IPC 對 PP 的建議強度高於 RPP。RPP 的活塞-缸體機構是機械精密配合，劑量非常穩定，統計 IPC 的誤差風險相對低；PP 則因為管路持續老化，「每一個容器的充填量都可能和上一個不一樣」，100% 稱重是唯一能確保每個容器都在規格內的方法。
blocks.en: Conclusion: the recommendation for 100% IPC is stronger for PP than for RPP. The piston-cylinder mechanism of an RPP is a precision mechanical fit with very stable dosing, so the risk of error with statistical IPC is relatively low; with PP, because the tubing keeps ageing, "the fill volume of every container may differ from the previous one", and 100% weighing is the only way to make sure every container is within specification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：水管接頭的隱形滲漏
blocks.en: Analogy: The Invisible Leak at a Pipe Joint

blocks.zh: 想像一條家用水管在牆內輕微滲漏。你每天用水，水壓表看起來正常，但牆壁裡已經悄悄濕了。等你發現問題，可能已經發了幾個月的霉。
blocks.en: Imagine a household water pipe leaking slightly inside the wall. You use water every day and the pressure gauge looks normal, but the wall has been quietly getting wet. By the time you notice, mold may have been growing for months.

blocks.zh: PP 管路的小裂縫就是這樣的「隱形問題」。統計 IPC 就像每天只看一次水壓表——發現不了慢性滲漏；100% IPC 就像每個容器都有獨立的流量計——任何偏差即時可見。
blocks.en: A small crack in PP tubing is this kind of "invisible problem". Statistical IPC is like reading the pressure gauge once a day: it cannot detect a chronic leak. 100% IPC is like giving every container its own flow meter: any deviation is visible immediately.

blocks.zh: 你正在驗證一個 PP + SU 系統，充填批次時長為 8 小時。你打算如何設計「管路使用時間驗證」研究？哪些變數需要被納入（產品種類、溫度、轉速）？
blocks.en: You are validating a PP + SU system with a fill batch duration of 8 hours. How would you design the "tubing use-time validation" study? Which variables should be included (product type, temperature, pump speed)?

blocks.zh: 客戶問：「為什麼你們 PP 生產線的 E&L 測試比 RPP 貴這麼多？」請用這個章節的邏輯解釋。
blocks.en: A client asks: "Why is E&L testing for your PP line so much more expensive than for RPP?" Explain using the logic of this section.

blocks.zh: 若充填劇毒產品（potent product），PP 泵放在隔離器外 vs 隔離器內，SA 風險如何變化？什麼條件下才需要放到隔離器內？
blocks.en: When filling a potent product, how does the SA risk change between placing the PP pump outside the isolator and inside it? Under what conditions does it need to be placed inside the isolator?

blocks.zh: 2.1.6 Peristaltic Pump Efficiency and Impact on Risk 2.1.6 蠕動泵效率與風險影響
blocks.en: 2.1.6 Peristaltic Pump Efficiency and Impact on Risk

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PP 的效率優勢——伺服直驅
blocks.en: Core Concept: The PP Efficiency Advantage - Direct Servo Drive

blocks.zh: PP 的機械傳動路徑極短：伺服馬達 → 轉子 → 滾輪 → 管壁壓縮 → 液體推進，中間沒有齒輪組、沒有機械密封、沒有複雜連桿。
blocks.en: The mechanical drive path of PP is very short: servo motor → rotor → roller → tube wall compression → liquid propulsion, with no gear set, no mechanical seal and no complex linkage in between.

blocks.zh: 對比 RPP：馬達 → 齒輪箱 → 凸輪 → 活塞往復 → 進/出閥切換 → 液體推進，傳動鏈更長，摩擦損耗更大，磨損點也更多。
blocks.en: By comparison, RPP: motor → gearbox → cam → piston reciprocation → inlet/outlet valve switching → liquid propulsion. The drive chain is longer, friction losses are greater, and there are more wear points.

blocks.zh: PP 的結果：泵頭幾乎沒有機械磨損，使用壽命可達數年。真正需要管理的磨損件只有一個：矽膠管。
blocks.en: The result for PP: the pump head has almost no mechanical wear, and its service life can reach several years. The only wear part that really needs managing is the silicone tubing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：直驅電動車 vs 傳統燃油車變速箱
blocks.en: Analogy: Direct-Drive Electric Vehicle vs Conventional Gearbox Car

blocks.zh: 電動車直接用馬達驅動輪子，沒有變速箱，傳動效率接近 95%；傳統燃油車的能量要經過引擎 → 變速箱 → 傳動軸 → 輪子，每個環節都有摩擦損耗，整體效率只有 30-40%。
blocks.en: An electric vehicle drives the wheels directly with a motor, with no gearbox, and the drive efficiency is close to 95%. In a conventional fuel car, the energy passes through engine → gearbox → drive shaft → wheels, with friction loss at every stage, and the overall efficiency is only 30-40%.

blocks.zh: PP 的伺服直驅就像電動車——轉子直接驅動管路，幾乎沒有中間損耗。RPP 的齒輪傳動就像傳統變速箱——多了轉換步驟，也多了潛在的磨損點和維護需求。
blocks.en: The servo direct drive of PP is like the electric vehicle: the rotor drives the tubing directly, with almost no intermediate loss. The gear drive of RPP is like a conventional gearbox: there are more conversion steps, and also more potential wear points and maintenance needs.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：高毒性藥品的安裝位置決策
blocks.en: Key Point: Installation Position Decision for Highly Toxic Products

blocks.zh: PP 通常放在屏障外，但高活性藥物 (highly potent products，HPAPI) 是例外——這類產品要求 PP 放在隔離器內部。
blocks.en: PP is normally placed outside the barrier, but highly potent products (HPAPI) are an exception: for these products, the PP must be placed inside the isolator.

blocks.zh: 原因是邏輯相反：對一般藥品，我們擔心外部汙染進入藥品；對高毒性藥品，我們同時還要擔心藥品洩漏出去傷害操作人員。PP 管路的洩漏風險相對較高，若高毒性藥液洩漏在隔離器外，職業暴露風險難以接受。
blocks.en: The reason is that the logic is reversed. For ordinary drug products, we worry about external contamination entering the product; for highly potent products, we must also worry about the product leaking out and harming operators. PP tubing has a relatively high leak risk, and if a highly potent drug solution leaks outside the isolator, the occupational exposure risk is unacceptable.

blocks.zh: 管控措施：高毒性產品的 PP 應配備管路洩漏偵測系統（流量異常、液體感應器），一旦觸發立即停機並啟動偏差程序。
blocks.en: Control measure: a PP for highly potent products should be equipped with a tubing leak detection system (flow anomaly, liquid sensors); once triggered, it stops immediately and a deviation procedure is initiated.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：管路斷裂的 SOP 決策樹
blocks.en: Practical Application: SOP Decision Tree for Tubing Rupture

blocks.zh: 當 PP 管路在充填過程中斷裂，SOP 必須預先回答三個問題：
blocks.en: When PP tubing ruptures during filling, the SOP must answer three questions in advance:

blocks.zh: 1. 是否繼續充填？用剩餘正常泵頭繼續，還是停線？（取決於多泵頭配置、批次尺寸影響）
blocks.en: 1. Continue filling or not? Continue with the remaining healthy pump heads, or stop the line? (This depends on the multi-head configuration and the effect on batch size.)

blocks.zh: 2. 受影響容器如何處置？從斷裂點往回追溯到上一個確認良品的 IPC 點，中間所有容器隔離等待調查
blocks.en: 2. How are the affected containers handled? Trace back from the point of rupture to the last confirmed good IPC point, and quarantine all containers in between pending investigation

blocks.zh: 3. 偏差報告的範疇？管路斷裂是否觸發批次廢棄，或只是局部隔離？
blocks.en: 3. What is the scope of the deviation report? Does the tubing rupture trigger batch rejection, or only local quarantine?

blocks.zh: 這個決策樹必須在 SOP 中明確規定，不能在批次中臨時決定，否則會導致偏差處理不一致和法規風險。
blocks.en: This decision tree must be clearly defined in the SOP and cannot be decided on the spot during a batch; otherwise it leads to inconsistent deviation handling and regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: 你的 PP 充填線有 8 個泵頭，第 3 號泵頭在批次 50% 時管路斷裂。100% IPC 系統已配備。請描述你的決策步驟和需要隔離的容器範圍。
blocks.en: Your PP filling line has 8 pump heads, and the tubing on head no. 3 ruptures at 50% of the batch. A 100% IPC system is in place. Describe your decision steps and the range of containers that must be quarantined.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PP 的可視性（visibility）是 SA 的優勢？不可見的設備設計（如封閉在機台內部的 RPP）會帶來什麼樣的操作風險？
blocks.en: Why is the visibility of PP an SA advantage? What operational risks come with equipment designs that are not visible (such as an RPP enclosed inside the machine)?

blocks.zh: 2.1.7 Peristaltic Pump Costs: Initial and Lifecycle 2.1.7 蠕動泵成本：初始與生命週期
blocks.en: 2.1.7 Peristaltic Pump Costs: Initial and Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TCO = 總擁有成本的完整視野
blocks.en: Core Concept: TCO - the Complete View of Total Cost of Ownership

blocks.zh: 總擁有成本 (Total Cost of Ownership, TCO) 是比較不同充填技術的正確框架，而不是只看「設備採購價」。PP + SU 系統的 TCO 計算需要涵蓋：
blocks.en: Total cost of ownership (TCO) is the correct framework for comparing different filling technologies, rather than looking only at the "equipment purchase price". The TCO calculation for a PP + SU system needs to cover:

blocks.zh: 初始資本支出：設備本身（PP 與 RPP 相近）
blocks.en: Initial capital expenditure: the equipment itself (PP and RPP are similar)

blocks.zh: SU 耗材費：每批次管路組、接頭、針頭（持續發生）
blocks.en: SU consumable costs: tubing set, connectors and needles for every batch (recurring)

blocks.zh: 驗證成本：E&L 測試、管路使用時間驗證、IPC 系統驗證
blocks.en: Validation costs: E&L testing, tubing use-time validation, IPC system validation

blocks.zh: 運營成本：清洗驗證（RPP 需要，PP SU 不需要）、WFI 消耗、潔淨蒸汽
blocks.en: Operating costs: cleaning validation (required for RPP, not for PP SU), WFI consumption, clean steam

blocks.zh: 停機成本：CIP/SIP 週期佔用的批次間時間（RPP 較長）
blocks.en: Downtime costs: time between batches taken up by CIP/SIP cycles (longer for RPP)

blocks.zh: 人員訓練：PP 複雜度低，訓練成本較低
blocks.en: Personnel training: PP has low complexity, so training costs are lower

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：買車的全生命週期成本
blocks.en: Analogy: Lifecycle Cost of Buying a Car

blocks.zh: 選購汽車，你不能只看「車價」。電動車 (EV) 購買價比同級燃油車貴 20-30%，但：
blocks.en: When buying a car you cannot look only at the "car price". An electric vehicle (EV) costs 20-30% more to buy than a comparable fuel car, but:

blocks.zh: 電費 vs 油費（SU 耗材 vs 公用設施費用）
blocks.en: Electricity vs fuel (SU consumables vs utility costs)

blocks.zh: 零維修 vs 定期換機油/煞車片（低維護 vs CIP/SIP 維護費）
blocks.en: No servicing vs regular oil/brake pad changes (low maintenance vs CIP/SIP maintenance costs)

blocks.zh: 電池壽命 vs 引擎大修（泵頭使用壽命 vs 活塞缸體替換）
blocks.en: Battery life vs engine overhaul (pump head service life vs piston/cylinder replacement)

blocks.zh: PP + SU 就像電動車：買車便宜，但電費（耗材）持續花；RPP + CIP/SIP 就像燃油車：買車便宜，但油錢和維修費也持續花。誰划算取決於你的使用強度（批次量）和油價（耗材單價）。
blocks.en: PP + SU is like an electric vehicle: the purchase is cheap but the electricity (consumables) keeps costing money; RPP + CIP/SIP is like a fuel car: the purchase is cheap but fuel and repairs also keep costing money. Which is more economical depends on your usage intensity (batch volume) and fuel price (consumable unit price).

blocks.zh: TCO 的目的就是把這兩條成本曲線繪出來，找到「交叉點」——在哪個批次量以下 SU 更划算，以上 RPP 更划算。
blocks.en: The purpose of TCO is to plot these two cost curves and find the "crossover point": below which batch volume SU is more economical, and above which RPP is more economical.

blocks.zh: 公式：PP vs RPP 的 TCO 比較框架
blocks.en: Formula: TCO Comparison Framework for PP vs RPP

blocks.zh:
PP (SU) 年度 TCO =
  資本折舊（設備÷年限）
+ SU 管路組 × 批次數/年
+ E&L 驗證（攤提）
+ 管路使用時間驗證（攤提）
+ 100% IPC 系統維護
+ 操作員訓練（低）
─────────────────────────
RPP (CIP/SIP) 年度 TCO =
  資本折舊（設備÷年限，含 CIP/SIP 系統）
+ 清洗驗證（年度再確認）
+ WFI 消耗 × 批次數/年
+ 潔淨蒸汽 × 批次數/年
+ 停機時間成本（CIP/SIP 週期）
+ 活塞/缸體定期更換
+ 操作員訓練（較高）

TCO 決策點：
  批次數低 → SU PP 通常勝出（避免固定 CIP/SIP 成本）
  批次數高 → RPP 可能反轉（SU 耗材累積超過 CIP/SIP 固定成本）
blocks.en:
PP (SU) annual TCO =
  Capital depreciation (equipment ÷ years)
+ SU tubing sets × batches/year
+ E&L validation (amortized)
+ Tubing use-time validation (amortized)
+ 100% IPC system maintenance
+ Operator training (low)
─────────────────────────
RPP (CIP/SIP) annual TCO =
  Capital depreciation (equipment ÷ years, including CIP/SIP system)
+ Cleaning validation (annual revalidation)
+ WFI consumption × batches/year
+ Clean steam × batches/year
+ Downtime cost (CIP/SIP cycles)
+ Periodic piston/cylinder replacement
+ Operator training (higher)

TCO decision point:
  Low batch count → SU PP usually wins (avoids fixed CIP/SIP costs)
  High batch count → RPP may reverse the result (accumulated SU consumables exceed fixed CIP/SIP costs)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的 TCO 特殊考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Special TCO Considerations for a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 不是單一產品生產商，TCO 計算有額外維度：
blocks.en: A CDMO is not a single-product manufacturer, so the TCO calculation has additional dimensions:

blocks.zh: 換品項清潔成本：PP + SU 整個管路丟棄，交叉汙染風險幾乎為零，不需要清潔驗證；RPP 需要每次換產品做清潔驗證，法規文件成本高
blocks.en: Changeover cleaning cost: with PP + SU the whole tubing path is discarded, so the cross-contamination risk is almost zero and no cleaning validation is needed; RPP needs cleaning validation at every product change, with high regulatory documentation costs

blocks.zh: 單一供應商風險：PP 的 SU 管路組往往來自特定 OEM，供應鏈斷鏈（如 COVID-19 期間）會導致整條生產線停擺。TCO 中要納入「供應中斷保險費用」（雙供應商認證、緩衝庫存）
blocks.en: Single-supplier risk: PP SU tubing sets often come from a specific OEM, and a supply chain break (such as during COVID-19) can bring the whole production line to a halt. The TCO should include a "supply interruption insurance cost" (dual-supplier qualification, buffer stock)

blocks.zh: 多品項共用設備：PP 泵頭可服務廣泛劑量範圍，CDMO 設備利用率更高，分攤的資本折舊更低
blocks.en: Shared equipment for multiple products: a PP pump head can serve a wide dose range, giving the CDMO higher equipment utilization and lower allocated capital depreciation

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 每年充填 50 批次某蛋白質藥物（2 mL/瓶）。SU 管路組每套 €800，RPP + CIP/SIP 系統的年運營成本（不含設備折舊）估計 €30,000。問：大約幾個批次是 SU vs RPP 的 TCO 交叉點？
blocks.en: Your CDMO fills 50 batches per year of a protein drug (2 mL/vial). Each SU tubing set costs €800, and the annual operating cost of an RPP + CIP/SIP system (excluding equipment depreciation) is estimated at €30,000. Question: roughly how many batches is the TCO crossover point between SU and RPP?

blocks.zh: 一個供應商提供的 PP SU 管路組被召回，你的生產線如何應對？TCO 分析中如何量化這個「供應鏈風險」？
blocks.en: The PP SU tubing set from one supplier is recalled. How does your production line respond? How can this "supply chain risk" be quantified in the TCO analysis?

blocks.zh: 2.1.8 Peristaltic Pump System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover 2.1.8 蠕動泵系統複雜度：安裝、操作與換線
blocks.en: 2.1.8 Peristaltic Pump System Complexity: Setup, Handling, and Changeover

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PP 系統複雜度極低的兩個維度
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Dimensions of Very Low PP System Complexity

blocks.zh: PP 的低複雜度體現在：
blocks.en: The low complexity of PP shows up in:

blocks.zh: 機械複雜度：整個泵只有轉子 (rotor) + 外殼 (housing) 兩個主要部件。沒有閥門、沒有密封圈、沒有活塞。安裝流程可以由訓練後的操作員在幾分鐘內完成，不需要工程師。
blocks.en: Mechanical complexity: the whole pump has only two main parts, the rotor and the housing. There are no valves, no seals and no pistons. A trained operator can complete the installation in a few minutes, without an engineer.

blocks.zh: 無菌管控複雜度：泵體本身不接觸藥品，因此不需要無菌連接、不需要就地滅菌。氫氧化氫 (vaporized hydrogen peroxide, VHP) 生物去汙或標準消毒程序即已足夠。唯一需要無菌管理的是管路本身——但 SU 管路出廠前已經伽瑪滅菌，直接安裝即可。
blocks.en: Sterile control complexity: the pump body itself does not contact the product, so no aseptic connection and no sterilize-in-place are needed. Vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP) biodecontamination or standard disinfection procedures are sufficient. The only item that needs sterile management is the tubing itself, but SU tubing is gamma-sterilized before it leaves the supplier and can be installed directly.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：管路幾何尺寸的批間變異——為什麼每次都要重新確認充填量
blocks.en: Key Point: Batch-to-Batch Variation in Tubing Geometry - Why the Fill Volume Must Be Reconfirmed Every Time

blocks.zh: 這是 PP 操作中最常被低估的風險：同一廠牌、同一型號的矽膠管，不同批次之間可能有微小的 ID、OD、壁厚、彈性差異。
blocks.en: This is the most underestimated risk in PP operation: silicone tubing of the same brand and model may show small differences in ID, OD, wall thickness and elasticity between batches.

blocks.zh: PP 的劑量精確度直接來自管路的內徑（每轉一圈擠出的體積 = 管截面積 × 滾輪壓縮長度）。如果新批次管路的 ID 比上批次大 0.1 mm，每次充填量就會系統性偏高。
blocks.en: The dosing accuracy of PP comes directly from the inner diameter of the tubing (volume delivered per revolution = tube cross-sectional area × length compressed by the roller). If the ID of a new batch of tubing is 0.1 mm larger than the previous batch, every fill volume will be systematically high.

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：每次換新批次管路（換批次管路，不只是換批次藥品）時，都要重新執行充填量設定（gravimetric calibration），確認新管路的實際充填量符合目標值再開始生產。
blocks.en: Best practice: every time a new batch of tubing is introduced (a new tubing lot, not just a new product batch), re-run the fill volume setup (gravimetric calibration) and confirm that the actual fill volume with the new tubing meets the target before starting production.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：防錯設計 (Mistake-Proofing) 的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of Mistake-Proofing

blocks.zh: 管夾 (tube clip) 的安裝是 PP 設定中唯一高風險的手動操作步驟。固定端 (fixed side) 和活動端 (loose side) 若裝反，管路會在充填時脫落或造成劑量偏差。
blocks.en: Installing the tube clip is the only high-risk manual step in PP setup. If the fixed side and the loose side are reversed, the tubing may come off during filling or cause dose deviations.

blocks.zh: 防錯機制的實務標準：
blocks.en: Practical standards for mistake-proofing:

blocks.zh: 管夾兩端顏色不同（視覺辨識）
blocks.en: Different colors on the two ends of the tube clip (visual identification)

blocks.zh: SOP 配帶照片（正確安裝的示意圖）
blocks.en: Photos in the SOP (diagram of correct installation)

blocks.zh: 管路上標示流向箭頭（防止裝反方向）
blocks.en: Flow direction arrows marked on the tubing (to prevent reversed installation)

blocks.zh: 安裝後必須有第二人確認（雙人核查）
blocks.en: A second person must verify after installation (two-person check)

blocks.zh: 這是 GMP 中防錯 (poka-yoke) 設計原則的典型應用。
blocks.en: This is a typical application of the poka-yoke (mistake-proofing) design principle in GMP.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：F1 進站換胎 vs 普通換胎店
blocks.en: Analogy: F1 Pit Stop vs an Ordinary Tire Shop

blocks.zh: PP 的換管路操作可以像 F1 進站換胎（設計精良、步驟明確、防錯措施完備）——只需 2-3 分鐘。但若沒有良好的防錯設計（管夾方向標示、SOP 照片），同樣的操作就會像普通換胎店：靠師傅的個人經驗，每次結果不一樣。
blocks.en: Changing PP tubing can be like an F1 pit stop (well designed, clear steps, complete mistake-proofing) and take only 2-3 minutes. Without good mistake-proofing (tube clip direction marking, SOP photos), the same operation becomes like an ordinary tire shop: it relies on the individual experience of the technician, and the result differs every time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的挑戰：操作員可能在一天內換多個不同規格的管路，防錯設計的一致性直接影響批次成功率。
blocks.en: The CDMO challenge: operators may change tubing of several different formats in one day, so the consistency of mistake-proofing directly affects batch success rate.

blocks.zh: 100% IPC 的必要性邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic Behind the Need for 100% IPC

blocks.zh:
PP 劑量偏差的來源有三個：
  1. 管路批次間幾何變異（每批次一次性）
  2. 管路在批次內的磨損（隨時間漸進）
  3. 管路微小裂縫導致的突發洩漏（隨機）

前兩個是「漸進型」偏差，統計 IPC 可部分捕捉；
第三個是「突發型」偏差，只有 100% IPC 才能確保
每一個容器在可接受範圍內。

結論：
  PP 的推薦 IPC 策略 = 100% 稱重 (gravimetric check)
  若採用統計 IPC，需要：
    - 高頻率的批次開始監控
    - 長批次中期監控（補捉磨損影響）
    - 詳細的風險評估文件
blocks.en:
There are three sources of PP dose deviation:
  1. Tubing geometry variation between lots (once per lot)
  2. Tubing wear within a batch (progressive over time)
  3. Sudden leakage from small cracks in the tubing (random)

The first two are "progressive" deviations that statistical IPC can partly capture;
the third is a "sudden" deviation, and only 100% IPC can ensure
that every container is within the acceptable range.

Conclusion:
  Recommended IPC strategy for PP = 100% weighing (gravimetric check)
  If statistical IPC is used, the following are needed:
    - High-frequency monitoring at batch start
    - Mid-batch monitoring for long batches (to capture the effect of wear)
    - Detailed risk assessment documentation

blocks.zh: 你的 PP 充填線今天換了新批次管路（相同型號，但新批次）。SOP 上應該要求操作員做哪些步驟才能開始正式生產？
blocks.en: Your PP filling line changed to a new lot of tubing today (same model, but a new lot). Which steps should the SOP require the operator to complete before formal production can start?

blocks.zh: 某操作員宣稱：「上次批次用了 100% IPC，這次同一條管路繼續用，可以改成統計 IPC 嗎？」你如何評估這個請求的合理性？
blocks.en: An operator claims: "We used 100% IPC last batch and we are continuing with the same tubing, so can we switch to statistical IPC?" How do you assess the reasonableness of this request?

blocks.zh: 2.1.9 Peristaltic Pump Maintenance and Aging 2.1.9 蠕動泵維護保養與老化
blocks.en: 2.1.9 Peristaltic Pump Maintenance and Aging

blocks.zh: 核心概念：維護工作的重心轉移
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Shift in Maintenance Focus

blocks.zh: PP 系統的維護哲學與 RPP 完全不同。RPP 需要定期維護活塞、缸體、閥門、密封件等多個機械零件；PP 的維護工作幾乎全部集中在一個地方：管路。
blocks.en: The maintenance philosophy for PP systems is completely different from that for RPP. RPP requires regular maintenance of many mechanical parts such as pistons, cylinders, valves and seals; the maintenance of PP is concentrated almost entirely in one place: the tubing.

blocks.zh: 這個特點對 CDMO 的設備管理有實務意義：
blocks.en: This characteristic has practical significance for CDMO equipment management:

blocks.zh: 預防性維護 (PM) 計畫簡化：主要 PM 項目就是確認管路更換週期和滾輪軸承狀態檢查
blocks.en: Simplified preventive maintenance (PM) plan: the main PM items are confirming the tubing replacement interval and checking the condition of the roller bearings

blocks.zh: 備件庫存簡化：不需要備大量機械零件，主要備品就是管路組（已有 SU 批量採購）
blocks.en: Simplified spare parts inventory: there is no need to stock many mechanical parts, and the main spare is the tubing set (already bought in bulk as SU)

blocks.zh: 技術要求降低：維護不需要專業機械工程師，訓練後的操作員即可執行大多數例行維護
blocks.en: Lower technical requirements: maintenance does not require a specialist mechanical engineer, and trained operators can perform most routine maintenance

blocks.zh: 重點提示：伺服馬達的 OEM 替換策略
blocks.en: Key Point: OEM Replacement Strategy for Servo Motors

blocks.zh: 雖然伺服馬達故障頻率極低，但一旦在批次中途失效，後果嚴重：
blocks.en: Although servo motor failures are very rare, a failure in the middle of a batch has serious consequences:

blocks.zh: 批次中斷 → 可能廢棄（特別是高值藥品）
blocks.en: Batch interruption → possible rejection (especially for high-value products)

blocks.zh: 維修時間不確定 → 影響交貨期
blocks.en: Uncertain repair time → affects delivery dates

blocks.zh: OEM 零件供應時間（尤其是進口設備）可能數週
blocks.en: OEM parts lead time (especially for imported equipment) may be several weeks

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：向 OEM 索取「伺服馬達預防性替換週期」（通常以運轉小時數計），並在設備履歷中追蹤每個馬達的累計小時數。在替換週期到達前的計畫停機期間主動更換，避免非計畫性停機。
blocks.en: Best practice: ask the OEM for the "servo motor preventive replacement interval" (usually in operating hours), and track the cumulative hours of each motor in the equipment history. Replace proactively during planned downtime before the replacement interval is reached, to avoid unplanned downtime.

blocks.zh: 對高產量 CDMO 生產線：建議庫存 1-2 個備用伺服馬達，保持 24 小時內可更換的能力。
blocks.en: For high-volume CDMO production lines: it is recommended to stock 1-2 spare servo motors, so that a replacement can be made within 24 hours.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：印表機的維護哲學
blocks.en: Analogy: The Maintenance Philosophy of a Printer

blocks.zh: 噴墨印表機的硬體（列印頭、馬達、滾輪）設計為長期使用，幾乎不需要更換；真正需要持續補充和管理的是墨水匣（耗材）。
blocks.en: The hardware of an inkjet printer (print head, motor, rollers) is designed for long-term use and almost never needs replacement; what needs continual replenishment and management is the ink cartridge (the consumable).

blocks.zh: PP 系統就像高端噴墨印表機：機器本身近乎免維護，但墨水匣（矽膠管路）的管理才是營運的核心——及時補貨、確認規格批次、驗證使用壽命。
blocks.en: A PP system is like a high-end inkjet printer: the machine itself is almost maintenance-free, but management of the ink cartridge (the silicone tubing) is the core of the operation: reorder in time, confirm the specification and lot, and validate the service life.

blocks.zh: 建立一份 PP 充填系統的年度維護計畫大綱，列出應包含的項目（管路相關、泵頭相關、馬達相關），並標示每個項目的頻率依據（OEM 建議、使用時間、批次數）。
blocks.en: Outline an annual maintenance plan for a PP filling system, listing the items it should include (tubing-related, pump head-related, motor-related), and indicate the basis for the frequency of each item (OEM recommendation, operating time, number of batches).

blocks.zh: 對一台每年充填 100 批次的 PP，如何決定「是否應該庫存備用伺服馬達」的採購策略？
blocks.en: For a PP that fills 100 batches per year, how would you decide the purchasing strategy on "whether a spare servo motor should be stocked"?

blocks.zh: 2.1.10 Peristaltic Pump Single-Use Versus Reusable Strategy 2.1.10 蠕動泵拋棄式與重複使用策略
blocks.en: 2.1.10 Peristaltic Pump Single-Use Versus Reusable Strategy

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EU GMP Annex 1 的 SIP 要求是法規強制力
blocks.en: Core Concept: The SIP Requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 Is a Regulatory Mandate

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的核心要求：凡是直接接觸藥品的部件，只要工程上可行，都必須就地滅菌 (SIP)。
blocks.en: The core requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): any part in direct contact with the product must be sterilized in place (SIP) wherever this is technically feasible.

blocks.zh: 這條要求對 PP + 可重複使用管路的衝擊非常大：
blocks.en: This requirement has a very large impact on PP with reusable tubing:

blocks.zh: 若要使用可重複使用管路（reusable tubing），就必須設計 CIP/SIP 系統
blocks.en: To use reusable tubing, a CIP/SIP system must be designed

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 系統的設計、安裝、驗證費用高昂
blocks.en: The design, installation and validation of a CIP/SIP system are expensive

blocks.zh: PP 的管路如本章後續所述，CIP/SIP 在 PP 上有很多工程挑戰
blocks.en: For PP tubing, as described later in this chapter, CIP/SIP presents many engineering challenges

blocks.zh: 法規強制力的結果：選擇「不做 SIP」的可重複使用管路，在 EU 法規環境下幾乎是不被接受的。這使得 PP + SU（免 SIP）成為最省事的法規合規路徑。
blocks.en: The result of the regulatory mandate: choosing reusable tubing "without SIP" is almost unacceptable in the EU regulatory environment. This makes PP + SU (no SIP needed) the easiest route to regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：免洗餐具 vs 瓷器需要洗碗機
blocks.en: Analogy: Disposable Tableware vs Porcelain That Needs a Dishwasher

blocks.zh: 辦公室餐廳有兩種選擇：
blocks.en: An office canteen has two options:

blocks.zh: 免洗餐具 (SU 管路)：每次用完直接丟掉，不需要洗碗機，不需要驗證清潔程序，但每天都要採購耗材費用
blocks.en: Disposable tableware (SU tubing): throw it away after each use, no dishwasher and no validated cleaning procedure, but the cost of consumables has to be paid every day

blocks.zh: 瓷器餐具 (可重複使用管路)：初始採購貴，但需要工業洗碗機（CIP）+ 高溫消毒程序（SIP）+ 定期驗證餐具確實洗乾淨了（清潔驗證）
blocks.en: Porcelain tableware (reusable tubing): expensive to buy initially, and it needs an industrial dishwasher (CIP) + a high-temperature disinfection program (SIP) + regular validation that the tableware is really clean (cleaning validation)

blocks.zh: 在 Annex 1 的世界裡，瓷器餐廳還被強制規定「洗碗機必須達到特定溫度和循環標準（SIP 要求）」——如果達不到，就只能用免洗餐具。
blocks.en: In the world of Annex 1, the porcelain canteen is also required to ensure that "the dishwasher reaches a specific temperature and cycle standard (the SIP requirement)", and if it cannot, it can only use disposable tableware.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的高頻率換產品需求（每週可能換 3-4 個品項），讓免洗餐具的「零清潔驗證」優勢更加顯著。
blocks.en: The CDMO need for frequent product changes (perhaps 3-4 products per week) makes the "zero cleaning validation" advantage of disposable tableware even more significant.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SU 的供應鏈依賴風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Supply Chain Dependency Risk of SU

blocks.zh: SU 策略看似完美，但隱含一個重大的商業風險：高度依賴單一供應商。
blocks.en: The SU strategy looks perfect but carries a major commercial risk: high dependence on a single supplier.

blocks.zh: PP 的 SU 管路組通常需要與特定泵體設備相容（管徑、接頭規格、管夾尺寸），往往只有一到兩家 OEM 供應商提供相容品。若供應商：
blocks.en: PP SU tubing sets usually have to be compatible with a specific pump (tube diameter, connector specifications, tube clip size), and often only one or two OEM suppliers offer compatible products. If the supplier:

blocks.zh: 斷貨（原材料短缺）
blocks.en: Runs out of stock (raw material shortage)

blocks.zh: 停產某型號
blocks.en: Discontinues a model

blocks.zh: 品質問題導致召回
blocks.en: Has a quality problem leading to a recall

blocks.zh: 漲價（市場壟斷）
blocks.en: Raises prices (market monopoly)

blocks.zh: CDMO 的生產計畫可能立刻受到衝擊。
blocks.en: the CDMO production plan may be hit immediately.

blocks.zh: 風險管控：在商業協議中要求 OEM 提供 12-18 個月的提前通知（change notification），並評估是否需要認證替代供應商或建立緩衝庫存策略。
blocks.en: Risk control: require the OEM in the commercial agreement to give 12-18 months of advance notice (change notification), and assess whether an alternative supplier needs to be qualified or a buffer stock strategy established.

blocks.zh: 一個新客戶詢問：「你們 PP 生產線的管路是 SU 還是可重複使用的？為什麼？」請結合 Annex 1 要求、TCO 考量和操作複雜度，給出一個完整的回答。
blocks.en: A new client asks: "Is the tubing on your PP line single-use or reusable, and why?" Give a complete answer that combines the Annex 1 requirements, TCO considerations and operational complexity.

blocks.zh: 你的 PP SU 管路唯一供應商宣佈因原材料短缺，將暫停供貨 3 個月。你如何應對？哪些選項是可行的，哪些會引發法規問題？
blocks.en: The sole supplier of your PP SU tubing announces that it will suspend supply for 3 months because of a raw material shortage. How do you respond? Which options are feasible, and which would raise regulatory problems?

blocks.zh: 2.1.11 Peristaltic Pump Clean-In-Place/Sterilize-In-Place Feasibility and Pitfalls 2.1.11 蠕動泵就地清洗（CIP）／就地滅菌（SIP）可行性與陷阱
blocks.en: 2.1.11 Peristaltic Pump Clean-In-Place/Sterilize-In-Place Feasibility and Pitfalls

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PP 的 CIP/SIP 工程挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept: The CIP/SIP Engineering Challenges of PP

blocks.zh: 這一節解釋了為什麼「CIP/SIP rarely used for PP」（前面優缺點表中提到）。根本原因在於 PP 的物理結構與 CIP/SIP 程序之間存在根本性矛盾：
blocks.en: This section explains why "CIP/SIP rarely used for PP" (mentioned in the advantages and disadvantages table earlier). The root cause is a fundamental conflict between the physical structure of PP and the CIP/SIP process:

blocks.zh: 矛盾一：管路必須拆下才能 CIP/SIP
blocks.en: Conflict 1: The tubing must be removed for CIP/SIP

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 需要清潔液體或蒸汽能自由流通整個管路內腔。但 PP 的滾輪在正常狀態下是壓縮在管壁上的——這個壓縮正是泵的工作原理，但也恰好阻擋了流體通過。結果：執行 CIP/SIP 前，管路必須從泵頭上拆下。
blocks.en: CIP/SIP requires cleaning liquid or steam to flow freely through the whole tubing lumen. But in the normal state the PP rollers are compressed against the tube wall. This compression is exactly how the pump works, but it also blocks the passage of fluid. The result: before CIP/SIP is performed, the tubing must be removed from the pump head.

blocks.zh: 矛盾二：拆下後重新安裝是手動無菌操作
blocks.en: Conflict 2: Reinstallation after removal is a manual aseptic operation

blocks.zh: 管路做完 CIP/SIP 後，必須重新裝回泵頭——這是一個手動操作步驟，引入了無菌操作風險。SIP 的目的（提供無菌狀態的管路）被「SIP 後的手動安裝」部分抵消。
blocks.en: After CIP/SIP, the tubing must be fitted back onto the pump head. This is a manual step that introduces aseptic handling risk. The purpose of SIP (to provide sterile tubing) is partly undone by the "manual installation after SIP".

blocks.zh: PP CIP/SIP 的操作序列
blocks.en: The PP CIP/SIP Operating Sequence

blocks.zh:
若選擇 CIP/SIP 路徑，操作序列如下：

步驟 1: 管路拆離泵頭（必要，以確保流體暢通）
   ↓
步驟 2: 管路內腔 CIP（清洗液循環）
   ↓
步驟 3: 隔離器/RABS 外表面生物去汙（VHP 霧化）
   ↓（管路必須拆離夾具，讓 VHP 接觸所有表面）
步驟 4: WFI 沖洗 或 直接進行 SIP
   （若先做 VHP 生物去汙：SIP 可分解矽膠管內殘留 VHP）
   ↓
步驟 5: SIP（蒸汽滅菌，管路內腔達到 SAL 要求）
   ↓
步驟 6: 手動重新安裝管路至泵頭（高風險步驟！）
   ↓
步驟 7: 100% IPC 確認充填量後開始生產

風險集中點：步驟 6（手動無菌安裝）
→ 這正是 SU 路徑的核心優勢：完全省略步驟 6
blocks.en:
If the CIP/SIP route is chosen, the operating sequence is as follows:

Step 1: Remove tubing from pump head (necessary, to keep the fluid path clear)
   ↓
Step 2: CIP of tubing lumen (circulation of cleaning solution)
   ↓
Step 3: Biodecontamination of isolator/RABS outer surfaces (VHP fogging)
   ↓ (tubing must be removed from the clamps so that VHP reaches all surfaces)
Step 4: WFI rinse or go directly to SIP
   (if VHP biodecontamination was done first: SIP can break down residual VHP in the silicone tubing)
   ↓
Step 5: SIP (steam sterilization, tubing lumen reaches the required SAL)
   ↓
Step 6: Manually reinstall tubing onto the pump head (high-risk step!)
   ↓
Step 7: Confirm fill volume with 100% IPC, then start production

Risk concentration point: Step 6 (manual aseptic installation)
→ This is exactly the core advantage of the SU route: Step 6 is eliminated entirely

blocks.zh: 重點提示：VHP 被矽膠管吸收的問題
blocks.en: Key Point: VHP Absorption by Silicone Tubing

blocks.zh: 這是一個微妙但重要的化學問題：矽膠是多孔性材料，VHP（氣化過氧化氫）容易被矽膠管壁吸收。如果吸收的 VHP 沒有被完全去除，在後續的藥液充填中可能：
blocks.en: This is a subtle but important chemical issue: silicone is a porous material, and VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) is easily absorbed into the silicone tube wall. If the absorbed VHP is not completely removed, during subsequent product filling it may:

blocks.zh: 緩慢釋放 H₂O₂ 進入藥液（可浸出物問題）
blocks.en: Slowly release H₂O₂ into the drug solution (a leachables issue)

blocks.zh: 對蛋白質藥物造成氧化降解
blocks.en: Cause oxidative degradation of protein drugs

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在 VHP 生物去汙後，SIP（蒸汽）可有效分解殘留 VHP，降低風險。但這個去除效果必須通過驗證來確認（測量 SIP 後殘留 H₂O₂ 濃度）。
blocks.en: Solution: after VHP biodecontamination, SIP (steam) can effectively break down residual VHP and reduce the risk. However, the effectiveness of this removal must be confirmed through validation (measuring the residual H₂O₂ concentration after SIP).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：洗完碗之後還要用手擦乾
blocks.en: Analogy: Drying the Dishes by Hand After Washing

blocks.zh: 工業洗碗機（CIP）可以把瓷器洗得一塵不染，高溫消毒（SIP）可以殺死所有細菌——但如果消毒完後，廚師要用手把碗拿出來組裝擺盤，那雙手的細菌就可能重新汙染碗盤。
blocks.en: An industrial dishwasher (CIP) can get porcelain spotless, and high-temperature disinfection (SIP) can kill all bacteria, but if after disinfection the cook has to take the dishes out by hand to assemble and plate them, bacteria from those hands may contaminate them again.

blocks.zh: 這正是 PP CIP/SIP 的悖論：前面花了大力氣確保管路無菌，最後一步卻需要人工手動安裝——這個手動步驟把之前的努力變成了不確定因素。SU 的優勢在於：出廠已滅菌的管路，直接安裝，完全跳過這個手工步驟。
blocks.en: This is the paradox of PP CIP/SIP: great effort goes into making the tubing sterile, but the last step needs manual installation, and this manual step turns all the earlier effort into an uncertainty. The advantage of SU is that tubing sterilized at the supplier is installed directly, skipping this manual step entirely.

blocks.zh: 一個客戶因環保考量，堅持要求使用可重複使用管路（避免 SU 廢棄物）。你作為技術負責人，如何說明 CIP/SIP on PP 的挑戰，並提出替代方案或補充措施？
blocks.en: A client insists on reusable tubing for environmental reasons (to avoid SU waste). As technical lead, how would you explain the challenges of CIP/SIP on PP and propose alternatives or supplementary measures?

blocks.zh: 設計一個 PP CIP/SIP 驗證計畫的大綱：需要驗證哪些關鍵參數？接受標準是什麼？
blocks.en: Outline a PP CIP/SIP validation plan: which critical parameters need to be validated? What are the acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: 2.1.12 Peristaltic Pump Benefits and Risks 2.1.12 蠕動泵效益與風險
blocks.en: 2.1.12 Peristaltic Pump Benefits and Risks

blocks.zh: 核心概念：效益與風險的矩陣解讀
blocks.en: Core Concept: Reading the Benefit and Risk Matrix

blocks.zh: 這張表是整個 PP 章節的結構性總結。觀察這個表的模式：
blocks.en: This table is the structural summary of the whole PP chapter. Look at the patterns in the table:

blocks.zh: 效益側的共同主題：「簡單」
blocks.en: Common theme on the benefit side: "simplicity"

blocks.zh: 裝配簡單、維護簡單、技術要求低、操作成本低
blocks.en: Simple assembly, simple maintenance, low technical requirements, low operating costs

blocks.zh: 這些簡單特性都來自同一個根源：PP 的封閉系統設計 + SU 策略的結合
blocks.en: These simple characteristics all come from the same root: the closed system design of PP combined with the SU strategy

blocks.zh: 風險側的共同主題：「管路的脆弱性」
blocks.en: Common theme on the risk side: "fragility of the tubing"

blocks.zh: 供應鏈依賴、磨損、破裂、黏度限制——全部都與管路有關
blocks.en: Supply chain dependency, wear, rupture, viscosity limits: all are related to the tubing

blocks.zh: 這些風險也都有同一個根源：矽膠管是整個系統中唯一既是耗損件又是關鍵安全屏障的部件
blocks.en: These risks also share the same root: silicone tubing is the only component in the whole system that is both a wear part and a critical safety barrier

blocks.zh: 重點提示：PP 不適合感測器充填 (sensor-filling)
blocks.en: Key Point: PP Is Not Suitable for Sensor-Filling

blocks.zh: 「感測器充填」是指依靠液位感應或重量感測器，在達到目標充填量後，即時發出停止信號的充填控制方式，常用於容器容量有限（如小瓶、眼用藥）或泡沫敏感的場景。
blocks.en: "Sensor-filling" is a fill control method that relies on a level sensor or weight sensor to send a stop signal in real time once the target fill volume is reached. It is often used where container capacity is limited (such as small vials and ophthalmic products) or in foam-sensitive applications.

blocks.zh: PP 的問題：軟管的彈性使管路中存在一定的流體慣性（管路壓縮後需要一小段時間才能完全停止出液），感測器觸發停止信號到實際停止出液之間有延遲，導致過充填。
blocks.en: The problem with PP: the elasticity of the flexible tubing creates a certain fluid inertia in the line (after the tubing is compressed it takes a short time for flow to stop completely), so there is a delay between the sensor triggering the stop signal and the flow actually stopping, which leads to overfilling.

blocks.zh: TP（時間壓力充填）的感測器反應更靈敏，適合需要精確液位控制的容器類型。CDMO 在接收這類容器規格時，應優先評估 TP 而非 PP。
blocks.en: TP (time-pressure filling) has a more responsive sensor reaction and suits container types that need precise level control. When a CDMO receives such container specifications, TP should be evaluated before PP.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：PP 技術的 CDMO 適用場景總結
blocks.en: Practical Application: Summary of CDMO Use Cases for PP Technology

blocks.zh: PP 最理想的場景：
blocks.en: Ideal scenarios for PP:

blocks.zh: 多劑量規格共線（劑量範圍廣的優勢最大化）
blocks.en: Multiple dose formats on one line (the wide dose range advantage is maximized)

blocks.zh: 低到中黏度注射劑（緩衝液、生物製劑、小分子水溶液）
blocks.en: Low- to medium-viscosity injectables (buffers, biologics, aqueous small molecule solutions)

blocks.zh: 高頻率換品項（SU 的無清潔驗證優勢最大化）
blocks.en: Frequent product changeovers (the no-cleaning-validation advantage of SU is maximized)

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（低剪切的優勢最重要）
blocks.en: Biologics (the low-shear advantage matters most)

blocks.zh: 預臨床/臨床早期小批量（低資本投入、快速啟動）
blocks.en: Preclinical/early clinical small batches (low capital investment, quick start-up)

blocks.zh: PP 應謹慎評估或避免的場景：
blocks.en: Scenarios where PP should be assessed carefully or avoided:

blocks.zh: 高黏度製劑（懸浮液、脂質製劑的高黏度版本）
blocks.en: High-viscosity formulations (suspensions, high-viscosity versions of lipid formulations)

blocks.zh: 需要感測器充填的小容量高精度容器
blocks.en: Small-volume, high-precision containers that need sensor-filling

blocks.zh: 含有機溶劑的製劑（加速管路降解）
blocks.en: Formulations containing organic solvents (which accelerate tubing degradation)

blocks.zh: 超高毒性 HPAPI（需放置隔離器內，增加設計複雜度）
blocks.en: Ultra-potent HPAPI (which must be placed inside the isolator, adding design complexity)

blocks.zh: 極高批次量 + 無法接受 SU 耗材持續費用的成本結構
blocks.en: Cost structures with very high batch volumes where the continuing cost of SU consumables is unacceptable

blocks.zh: PP 技術選型速查決策框架
blocks.en: PP Technology Selection Quick Decision Framework

blocks.zh:
問題 1: 產品黏度是否高？
  是 → 優先考慮 RPP 或 TP，PP 不推薦
  否 → 繼續評估

問題 2: 是否需要感測器充填（液位觸發停止）？
  是 → 優先 TP，PP 不推薦
  否 → 繼續評估

問題 3: 是否為生物製劑/細胞治療（低剪切需求）？
  是 → PP 是優先選擇
  否 → 繼續評估

問題 4: CDMO 是否多品項共線且高頻換線？
  是 → PP + SU 的優勢顯著（清潔驗證成本最低）
  否 → 考慮 RPP + CIP/SIP 的固定成本是否合理

問題 5: 是否為 HPAPI（高毒性藥品）？
  是 → PP 仍可用，但需設計隔離器內安裝 + 洩漏偵測
  否 → PP 可放屏障外，操作最簡單
blocks.en:
Question 1: Is the product viscosity high?
  Yes → consider RPP or TP first; PP not recommended
  No → continue assessment

Question 2: Is sensor-filling (level-triggered stop) required?
  Yes → TP preferred; PP not recommended
  No → continue assessment

Question 3: Is it a biologic/cell therapy (low-shear requirement)?
  Yes → PP is the preferred choice
  No → continue assessment

Question 4: Does the CDMO run multiple products on one line with frequent changeovers?
  Yes → the advantages of PP + SU are significant (lowest cleaning validation cost)
  No → consider whether the fixed cost of RPP + CIP/SIP is justified

Question 5: Is it an HPAPI (highly potent product)?
  Yes → PP can still be used, but design for installation inside the isolator + leak detection
  No → PP can be placed outside the barrier, with the simplest operation

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：整體技術選型如同選廚房設備
blocks.en: Analogy: Overall Technology Selection Is Like Choosing Kitchen Equipment

blocks.zh: 選擇廚房設備時，你不會只買一種——你會根據料理類型選擇不同工具：
blocks.en: When choosing kitchen equipment you do not buy only one kind; you choose different tools according to the type of cooking:

blocks.zh: PP = 矽膠刮刀：輕柔、多功能、一次性衛生、清洗麻煩免了；但不適合攪拌黏稠麵糊
blocks.en: PP = silicone spatula: gentle, versatile, hygienic single use, no tedious washing; but not suitable for stirring thick batter

blocks.zh: RPP = 不鏽鋼攪拌器：耐用、精準、適合多種黏度；但每次用完需要徹底清洗
blocks.en: RPP = stainless steel mixer: durable, precise, suitable for many viscosities; but it needs thorough cleaning after every use

blocks.zh: TP = 量杯 + 定時閥：靠壓力和時間計量，最適合需要精確感測停止的場景
blocks.en: TP = measuring cup + timed valve: metering by pressure and time, best for situations that need precise sensor-based stopping

blocks.zh: 一個成熟的 CDMO 廚房，應該三樣都有，根據客戶的「料理需求」（產品特性）選擇正確的工具，而不是讓所有客戶的產品都用同一種工具充填。
blocks.en: A mature CDMO kitchen should have all three, and choose the right tool according to the client's "cooking needs" (product characteristics), rather than filling every client's product with the same tool.

blocks.zh: 用這章學到的效益/風險框架，為以下三個新客戶選擇充填技術並說明理由：
blocks.en: Using the benefit/risk framework learned in this chapter, choose a filling technology for each of the following three new clients and explain the reasons:

blocks.zh: 客戶 A：單株抗體，2 mL，每批 5,000 瓶，每年 12 批，低黏度
blocks.en: Client A: monoclonal antibody, 2 mL, 5,000 vials per batch, 12 batches per year, low viscosity

blocks.zh: 客戶 B：眼用製劑，0.5 mL，需要感測器停止充填，每年 50 批
blocks.en: Client B: ophthalmic formulation, 0.5 mL, requires sensor-based stop filling, 50 batches per year

blocks.zh: 客戶 C：高活性抗腫瘤小分子，含 DMSO 溶劑，1 mL/瓶，每年 3 批（臨床）
blocks.en: Client C: highly potent anti-tumor small molecule, containing DMSO solvent, 1 mL/vial, 3 batches per year (clinical)

blocks.zh: 回顧本章所有子節（2.1.4 至 2.1.12），PP 技術中哪一個面向對 CDMO 的日常運營影響最大？為什麼？
blocks.en: Looking back over all sub-sections of this chapter (2.1.4 to 2.1.12), which aspect of PP technology has the greatest impact on the day-to-day operation of a CDMO? Why?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (2.1.4–2.1.12)
blocks.en: Section Summary (2.1.4–2.1.12)

blocks.zh: 技術特性：PP 是低剪切、廣劑量範圍、低系統複雜度的充填技術，最核心的優勢是「封閉系統可置於無菌屏障外」；最核心的限制是「矽膠管路是唯一耗損點，也是所有 SA 風險的集中地」
blocks.en: Technical characteristics: PP is a low-shear filling technology with a wide dose range and low system complexity. Its core advantage is that "the closed system can be placed outside the sterile barrier"; its core limitation is that "the silicone tubing is the only wear point and the concentration point of all SA risks"

blocks.zh: SA 管控：管路使用時間驗證 + E&L 測試矩陣 + 100% IPC 是 PP 的三大 SA 支柱；PP 的 100% IPC 建議強度高於 RPP，因為 PP 的劑量受管路磨損和批次幾何變異影響更大
blocks.en: SA control: tubing use-time validation + E&L testing matrix + 100% IPC are the three SA pillars of PP; the recommendation for 100% IPC is stronger for PP than for RPP, because PP dosing is more affected by tubing wear and batch-to-batch geometric variation

blocks.zh: 成本結構：PP + SU 的 TCO 優勢在於：免清潔驗證、低維護費用、廣劑量範圍提高設備利用率；劣勢在於 SU 耗材的持續費用和供應鏈依賴風險
blocks.en: Cost structure: the TCO advantages of PP + SU are no cleaning validation, low maintenance costs, and a wide dose range that improves equipment utilization; the disadvantages are the continuing cost of SU consumables and the supply chain dependency risk

blocks.zh: 法規驅動：EU GMP Annex 1 的 SIP 要求，使可重複使用管路必須配備 CIP/SIP 系統，工程挑戰大；這是 PP + SU 成為主流選擇的關鍵法規背景
blocks.en: Regulatory driver: the SIP requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 means reusable tubing must be equipped with a CIP/SIP system, which is a major engineering challenge; this is the key regulatory background for PP + SU becoming the mainstream choice

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 陷阱：PP 的 CIP/SIP 有根本性工程矛盾（管路需拆除才能清洗，但 SIP 後需手動重新安裝）；實務上 PP 極少採用 CIP/SIP，SU 是幾乎所有 PP 安裝的首選策略
blocks.en: CIP/SIP pitfall: CIP/SIP for PP has a fundamental engineering contradiction (the tubing must be removed for cleaning, but must be manually reinstalled after SIP); in practice PP rarely uses CIP/SIP, and SU is the preferred strategy for almost all PP installations

blocks.zh: 選型決策：PP 適合低黏度、多規格、生物製劑、高頻換線的 CDMO 場景；不適合高黏度、感測器充填、含溶劑製劑的場景；HPAPI 使用 PP 需要額外的洩漏防護設計
blocks.en: Selection decision: PP suits CDMO scenarios with low viscosity, multiple formats, biologics and frequent changeovers; it does not suit high viscosity, sensor-filling and solvent-containing formulations; using PP for HPAPI requires additional leak containment design
